assessments.independent_judgment: Native 5-chlorosalicylate-grown MT1 MCI is purified to homogeneity. Gel-filtration 255±20 kDa and SDS40±2 kDa support the authors' inferred homo-octamer, rather than a calculated exact stoichiometry from these masses. Native trans-DLH is a separate protein. Coupled MCI/trans-DLH shifts 3-chloromuconate products toward maleylacetate; unavailable 4-chloromuconolactone is proposed, with 4-fluoro analogue actually tested. The integrated record preserves this distinction.

assessments.independent_judgment: RmK927 is Rm5004(pTH1459); Rm5004 is Rm1021 recA::Tn5; Rm1021 derives fromSU47. Purification uses this engineered host, IPTG plus protocatechuate, and activity-guided enrichment to near homogeneity. SDS shows PcaI36/38kDa doublet and PcaJ28kDa; alternative initiation is proposed. source_to_graph_addition.exact_excerpt: trans-DLH was significantly inhibited by the chelating agents EDTA and o-phenanthroline (Table 3).
source_to_graph_addition.preparation: Native MT1 harvested after late exponential growth with5-chlorosalicylate; purified to SDS-PAGE homogeneity. Separate from SalC/MCI and recombinant2008 metal-free CcaC preparation.
source_to_graph_addition.assay: 5mU trans-DLH/ml incubated with1 or10mM EDTA in50mM Tris-HCl pH7.5; enzyme activity determined with50µM trans-dienelactone depletion280nm. Table3 remaining activity relative uninhibited control:1mM27±3% at5min,17±3% at60min;10mM13±3%,7±3%;240min not determined.
source_to_graph_addition.boundary: Direct primary support applies to trans-dienelactone activity ENZRXN-15761 only. The4-chloromuconolactone substrate for ENZRXN-15760 was unavailable;4-fluoro analogue/coupled assay does not directly support its EDTA inhibition. No transfer to SalC or PcaD.
source_to_graph_addition.other_context: Table3 also reports high-concentration ZnCl2/CuCl2 effects on native trans-DLH. Distinct from metal-free apoenzyme Zn/Mn reactivation; no contradiction and no new formal-route step.
source_to_graph_addition.status: Optional bounded primary-evidence improvement; current database-only scope is conservative, not unsupported biological inflation.
